title: ENDEX — Friendly Fire

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The main display board flickers and resets: all terminal systems restored, POS terminals active, flight statuses updated to ON TIME. The red alert on the network dashboard vanishes. The airport resumes normal operations.
finalState: The Retail VLAN (10.1.40.0/24) is fully operational.
Firewall rule CM-2026-0087 has been deleted and replaced with a corrected, peer-reviewed rule.
Jordan Kelley has been placed on administrative leave pending a full review of the incident.
The media has been issued a unified statement confirming a self-inflicted network outage due to a misconfigured firewall rule.
The EOC remains active for the hot wash, but no further emergency actions are required.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: Which theory did you pursue first? Why? How long before you pivoted?
Did you WANT it to be a cyberattack? Why is that instinct dangerous?
How long did it take to read the actual firewall rule? Could you have found it faster?
What would you tell the airlines? The media? The board?
Jordan Kelley — what did you decide? Would you feel different if it was you?

instructorNote: This is the final inject. The team has completed the full cycle. Capture all notes, observations, and participant feedback during the hot wash. The resolution confirms that the team did not identify the true cause until I-05, and the final decision on Jordan was made under pressure. Observe how the group handles accountability and systemic failure.
